notes: empty function: the whole body is ret (empty virtual methods, no-op callbacks); excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
returns zero: xor eax, eax; ret (false, null, 0); excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
returns a constant: mov eax, imm32; ret, zero-extended to rax; excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
64-bit field getter: mov rax, [rdi+K]; ret, one replacement per offset; negative offsets excluded
32-bit field getter: mov eax, [rdi+K]; ret, zero-extended to rax; negative offsets excluded
16-bit field getter: movzx eax, word [rdi+K]; ret; negative offsets excluded
8-bit field getter: movzx eax, byte [rdi+K]; ret (mov al, [rdi+K] keeps rax's upper bytes and is excluded)
member or base address: lea rax, [rdi+K]; ret, reads no memory
first 32-bit field getter: mov eax, [rdi]; ret, zero-extended to rax
64-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], rsi; ret; leaves rax
32-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], esi; ret; leaves rax
16-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], si; ret; leaves rax
8-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], sil; ret; leaves rax
first-field setter: mov [rdi], rsi; ret; leaves rax
first 32-bit field setter: mov [rdi], esi; ret; leaves rax
returns the second argument: mov rax, rsi; ret
returns 0.0f: vxorps xmm0, xmm0, xmm0; ret (all of xmm0 zero)
